item.title: Blit 1.0.9
item.description: Blit 1.0.9. The naming presets now put a name that's all in lower case into title case: "south.park.s29e04…" becomes "South-Park_S29E04.mkv", and "the.lord.of.the.rings.2001…" becomes "The Lord of the Rings 2001.mkv". Names that already have capitals are left as they are. Title Case is also a step of its own in Rename N Items.
